title: Critical infrastructure and industry
description: Adapt reviews to software for energy, transport, water, digital infrastructure, manufacturing and the other sectors listed in NIS 2 Annex I and II.
context: Ask the security owner whether the organization or its customer is an essential or important entity under the national law transposing NIS 2 (Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Annex I and II). This sector preselects the nis2-essential-entity pattern.

When the product is placed on the EU market as software or a connected device, ask the legal owner whether the Cyber Resilience Act applies, and select the cyber-resilience-act-product pattern when it does.
Name the owner of operational technology changes and the maintenance window before changing software that controls physical processes.
